Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Pseudomonas aeruginosa, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Findings are consistent with an active bacterial UTI; clinical correlation and targeted antibiotic therapy are recommended.
